changes: A cleaner window: Segoe UI throughout, graph and workbook tabs told apart by icon, and a blue line on the window you work in.
Windows side by side or floating, and back again with Dock back or Dock all windows back.
Shape and line style pickers in the Plot group editor: every choice drawn at once, and a Set menu for whole lists.
Fixed: closing the last window or floating every tab no longer closes Patina; sheet tabs no longer run under the zoom control.
